text:
Cruzas por my memories as a rayo of moon
that lo ilumina all of a blanca poesía…
the ruiseñor cantaba his love. Colgaba a
fina escala of seda from your celosía.


was the night a river cristalino and sonorous,
that arrastraba in his ondas, toward the eternity,
nuestro love as a carabela of gold,
palpitantes the velas bajo the tempestad.


among a deshojamiento of románticas roses
of light, juntos surcamos Venecias fabulosas,
in a olvido eterno of all… your laúd


desgranaba in the night his inmortal serenata…
¡and al pie of the marmórea and altiva escalinata
nos esperaba the paje of nuestra youth!

translation.title: Nocturno of silver
